The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Regarding the operational processes in the HomeTech customer service department, the primary bottleneck is the lack of system integration. This fragmentation causes repeated data entry and significant delays as representatives manually switch between platforms. A secondary bottleneck is the absence of a centralized knowledge base, which leads to inconsistent information being provided to customers. To improve efficiency, HomeTech should integrate its software systems to eliminate redundant data entry and implement a centralized knowledge base to ensure consistent and accurate customer support.
